title: Hearty Irish Quinoa Hash
description: A comforting, pescatarian-friendly Irish dish featuring quinoa, onions, and smoky salmon, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning.
instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the salmon fillets, skin side up, and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Flip the salmon and cook until cooked through, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the cooked quinoa and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with chopped parsley.
